fact_text: Debt-to-equity style solvency ratios say little about a bank, because deposits and borrowings are the raw material of its business; banks are read with sector-specific ratios.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: A bank's spread is the gap between what it earns on loans and investments and what it pays depositors and lenders; it is the bank's core earnings margin.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: Advances-to-deposit ratio (ADR) is net advances divided by total deposits; it shows what share of the deposit base has been lent out, with the rest held as reserves or invested.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: The analyst said peer banks typically run an ADR around 40% to 50%, so a lower ADR means the bank has lent out less of its deposits than most of the sector.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: United Bank's ADR was about 26% on its 2025 balance sheet, with net advances of about Rs 1,369 billion against total deposits of about Rs 5,168 billion.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: United Bank's deposits rose to about Rs 5,168 billion in 2025 from about Rs 2,629 billion in 2024, roughly doubling, which the analyst linked to the Silk Bank acquisition.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: United Bank's investments were about Rs 9,956 billion on its 2025 balance sheet, which the analyst presented as where surplus deposits were placed instead of being lent.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: The analyst said a low ADR is a positive for United Bank's shareholders, because surplus funds earn more in investments than the spread on loans would give.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: United Bank held cash of about Rs 548 billion against deposits of about Rs 5,168 billion on its 2025 balance sheet, a cash-to-deposit ratio of about 10%.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: Cash-to-deposit ratio shows how much cash a bank keeps against deposits; banks hold it largely because of regulation and to meet withdrawals without a run on the bank.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: Equity-to-advances ratio shows what share of a bank's own capital backs its loans; the analyst described a moderate level as neither conservative nor aggressive lending.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)

fact_text: The Silk Bank acquisition brought that bank's deposits and advances onto United Bank's books, and the analyst said the combined balance sheet had not yet been fully digested.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Banking Sector Ratios Explained | ADR | Equity to Advances & Cash to Deposit | Part 10 |SCSTrade.com' (YouTube, 2026-04-04)
